en: The operator holds work in vendor-hosted workspaces — a ChatGPT Project first, others after — and has no machine access to it. Whatever is decided there is invisible to every instrument this repository has: it cannot be searched, cited, carried into a handover, or linked to the decision it produced. The obvious repair is the wrong one twice over. Scraping a page produces a corpus with no identity, no provenance and no way to tell a change from a re-render; and building the corpus into the layer the way tracked content is built would publish, on a public website, a body of private conversation the vendor holds under an authenticated session. ADR <n1/> settles the shape: the catalogue of workspaces is the repository's own statement and is tracked; the content is this checkout's state and is not.

Zřejmá náprava je špatná hned dvakrát. Scrapování stránky vytvoří korpus bez identity, bez provenience a bez možnosti rozlišit změnu od nového vykreslení; a vestavění korpusu do vrstvy tak, jak se staví sledovaný obsah, by na veřejném webu publikovalo tělo soukromé konverzace, kterou dodavatel drží pod ověřenou relací.
